rv.q: The production never manages to balance its mix of psychological horror and larky comedy.
This fails to strike the balance between moments of jump frights and delightful big laughs.
The production overall left me feeling somewhat empty.

cn.t: This 1920s horror-comedy mystery delivers preposterous pleasures and colorful characters in a larky update, though critics remain only moderately enthusiastic about its transition from classic film to stage.
